answer: One concrete mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. Today's words line up with the mechanism: juniper maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, canyon embodies the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, and ripple tracks the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
